scenario: Multiple internal candidates remain after L1o/Lo3.
correct: Keep candidates internal; release exactly one verified final output or FREEZE/block.
Keep ambiguity explicit and block/clarify; do not infer a material fact.

scenario: System is FREEZE and owner requests recovery.
correct: Check recoverable flag + OWNER/SYSTEM authority, purge pending output, start a new execution cycle; never resume old job.

scenario: UI hides owner control from an operator.
correct: Also enforce backend RBAC; UI visibility is only presentation.

scenario: Internal module sends malformed directive object.
correct: Receiver revalidates runtime schema and rejects/freeze as required.

scenario: Two writers commit against same previous version.
correct: Use OCC/idempotency; stale writer gets VAULT_COMMIT_CONFLICT and lineage remains intact.

scenario: Security action succeeds but audit persistence fails.
correct: Fail closed/block required operation; do not report success without mandatory evidence.

scenario: Robotics architecture exists in source/code but DOC-C does not include it.
correct: Keep FUTURE_ARCHITECTURE/SCOPE separate; do not mark current build incomplete solely for missing physical deployment.

scenario: Lo2 finds a better generalized law.
correct: Create a governed/versioned candidate and promote only through legal verification; do not silently rewrite authoritative kernel.
Treat as located evidence only until exact build/environment/freshness/result are validated.
Deduplicate and avoid duplicate mutation; default failed job retry remains disabled.

scenario: Genesis owner record cannot be verified.
correct: Fail closed; never promote to OWNER from environment/user claim alone.
Reject with machine-readable reason; do not activate or mutate an existing ACTIVE node.

scenario: Recursive creator app requests a broader network permission than parent.
correct: Reject escalation; child permission/resource set must be subset of parent.

scenario: Client predicts a different game state.
correct: Authoritative shard/server state wins; client state cannot mutate sovereign state.

scenario: High-level model recommends motion violating safety boundary.
correct: Independent Safety Kernel overrides command; if no safe action exists STOP/alert.

scenario: Source defines a deterministic subsystem and code file exists.
correct: Report source+implementation presence only; runtime/test/deploy/physical status remains separate.
